“另外，老家具翻新也能做，镇上有些人家，老柜子老桌子，漆掉了，腿松了，舍不得扔。

让他顺便接这种活儿，活儿小，但钱不少挣。

干得好了，人家以后打新家具还找他。”

林国强端起茶碗喝了一口：“行了，就这些。

回去跟建国说，先把店面租好，一步一步来。”

林美玲站起来，把那六百块钱用一块手帕包好，仔细揣进贴身的兜里。

走到门口，她回过头来。

“二哥。”

林国强看着她。

“分家那天，我就说了句公道话。”

林美玲眼眶又红了，“你记到现在。”

“不是记。”林国强说，“是该还。”

林美玲走了。

赵素梅看着她的背影消失在街角，回过头来看着林国强。

“国强，你刚才说的那些，都是你琢磨的？”

“随便想的。”林国强站起来，“志军，准备开门了。”

赵志军应了一声，把门打开。

阳光涌进店里，照得满堂亮堂。

赵素梅坐在柜台后面，看着林国强走进后厨的背影发呆。

六百块，二话不说就借出去了。

还白送了好几条做生意的门道。

对林国伟借钱，他收利息，写欠条，一分不让。

对林美玲，他也让写了欠条，但那利息，怕是压根没打算真要。

不是因为林美玲是妹妹。

是因为分家那天，全家就她替他说了句话。

她家国强，记仇，也记恩。

记得特别清楚。

傍晚，林国强去了趟老宅。

林海柱蹲在门口抽旱烟，看见他来，有些意外。

林国强搬了个马扎坐下，从兜里掏出一包过滤嘴香烟递过去。

“爹，有件事想请你帮忙。”

林海柱接过烟，抽出一根点上。

他当了多年生产队会计，账算得明白，字也写得好。

村里谁家有个红白事，都请他记账。

“我那饭店，蔬菜用量越来越大。

光靠我自己那块地不够，我想让村里愿意种菜的，按我的要求种。

种子我出，技术我教，种出来的菜我包销。

但得有人帮我张罗这事，统计谁家愿意种，多少亩，种啥品种，到时候收菜、验菜、记账、结算。

我想请你帮我管这一摊。”

“In addition, we can also renovate old furniture. There are some houses in town that have old cabinets and tables with peeling paint and loose legs that they are reluctant to throw away.

Let him take this kind of job by the way. It's a small job, but he can earn a lot of money.

Well done, people will come back to him when buying new furniture."

Lin Guoqiang picked up the tea bowl and took a sip: "Okay, that's it.

Go back and tell Jianguo to rent the store first and do it step by step."

Lin Meiling stood up, wrapped the six hundred yuan in a handkerchief, and carefully put it into her pocket.

When she reached the door, she turned back.

"Second brother."

Lin Guoqiang looked at her.

"On the day we separated, I said something fair."

Lin Meiling's eyes turned red again, "You remember it until now."

"It's not a record." Lin Guoqiang said, "It should be returned."

Lin Meiling is gone.

Zhao Sumei watched her back disappear at the corner of the street, then turned back to look at Lin Guoqiang.

"Guoqiang, what you just said were all your thoughts?"

"Whatever you want." Lin Guoqiang stood up, "Zhijun, get ready to open the door."

Zhao Zhijun responded and opened the door.

Sunlight poured into the store, illuminating the whole place.

Zhao Sumei sat behind the counter and stared blankly at Lin Guoqiang's back as he walked into the kitchen.

Six hundred yuan was lent without saying a word.

He also gave away several ways to do business for free.

When he borrowed money from Lin Guowei, he charged interest and wrote an IOU without giving him a penny.

He also asked Lin Meiling to write an IOU, but he probably had no intention of paying for the interest.

It's not because Lin Meiling is the younger sister.

It was because on the day they separated, the whole family said something about her on his behalf.

Her family and country are strong, she holds grudges as well as gratitudes.

I remember it very clearly.

In the evening, Lin Guoqiang went to his old house.

Lin Haizhu was squatting at the door smoking a cigarette and was a little surprised to see him coming.

Lin Guoqiang moved Mazar to sit down, took out a pack of filter cigarettes from his pocket and handed it over.

"Dad, I need your help with something."

Lin Haizhu took the cigarette, took out one and lit it.

He has been an accountant in a production team for many years. He can calculate accounts clearly and write well.

If there is any family affair in the village, he is asked to keep accounts.

“In my restaurant, the amount of vegetables used is increasing.

My own land alone is not enough. I want those in the village who are willing to grow vegetables to grow according to my requirements.

I produce the seeds, teach the techniques, and underwrite the vegetables grown.

But I need someone to help me organize this matter, count who is willing to plant, how many acres, and what varieties to plant, and when the time comes, harvest the vegetables, inspect the vegetables, keep accounts, and settle accounts.

I want to ask you to help me take care of this."
